title: MAT-free graphic arrangements over arbitrary fields are exactly the arrangements of finite simple strongly chordal graphs
author: Tran, Tan N.; Tsujie, Shuhei
work: MAT-free graphic arrangements and a characterization of strongly chordal graphs by edge-labeling
source_version: Algebraic Combinatorics 6 (2023), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/alco.319; exact official native/publisher version, posted2024-01-08
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs compatible edge labelings over the entire clique-intersection poset by a crown-free antichain leaf argument, complete-clique extension and overlap gluing, while the reverse direction controls maximal-label edges and excludes induced suns. This is a global constructive characterization, not a translation of arrangement definitions. All named standard prerequisites are explicit, and the described new core remains an actual required proof obligation in the complete source packet.
